description.zh: 任务结果回调URL，目前仅支持HTTP地址。
description.en: The callback URL for job results. Only HTTP URLs are supported.

description.zh: 待提取溯源水印文件的输入OSS地址。
description.en: The OSS address of the input file for trace watermark extraction.

description.zh:
提取任务参数，JSONString。目前支持设置参数如下：

- m3u8Type：算法类型，默认值为v1。

  - v1：提取绝对路径的m3u8。
  - v2：提取相对路径的m3u8。
description.en:
Parameters for the extraction job, specified as a JSON string. The following parameter is supported:

- m3u8Type: The algorithm type. Default: v1.

  - v1: Extracts an M3U8 file with an absolute path.

  - v2: Extracts an M3U8 file with a relative path.

description.zh: 可公网访问的视频URL链接。填写后优先将其作为任务输入，其次再考虑Input输入。
description.en: A publicly accessible URL of the video file. If specified, this URL is used as the job input and takes precedence over the Input parameter.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，最大长度1024字节。

title.zh: 提交溯源水印提取作业
title.en: Submit a Tracing Watermark Extraction Job

descriptions.zh:
- 目前数字水印相关接口只支持华东2（上海）、华北2（北京）地域使用。
- 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027615~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询溯源水印提取作业](~~2834787~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en:
- Digital watermark APIs are available only in the China (Shanghai) and China (Beijing) regions.

- This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027615~~). After you submit a job, a job ID is returned. The job is then queued for background processing. The final result is sent via a callback. You can also check the job status by calling the [Query Trace Extraction Job](~~2834787~~) operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mts submit-trace-extract-job --input Bucket_:_example_,_Location_:_oss-cn-shanghai_,_Object_:_example.mp4 --user-data 123 --call-back http://example.com/callback --url http://www.example.com/video/test.mp4 --params m3u8Type_:_v1 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
